pair_mask_rule.12_minute_pair: intersection of endpoint high-confidence masks, finite midpoint averaged field, abs(midpoint Br)>=50G and 12-pixel edge guard
pair_mask_rule.24_minute_centered_pair: intersection of both endpoint high-confidence masks AND the actual central-frame high-confidence mask, finite midpoint averaged field, abs(actual central Br)>=50G and 12-pixel edge guard

flux_balance_mask: same pair mask before the 50G threshold, with edge guard
